book.name: Motmangtiitwu
book.title: MOTMANGTIITWU Ni Joon Suh Wuungbaat Arah

content: Erah lih adi mot amang ehoh we tuptang adi rangmong ni kaaluung daap choi ang arah tuptang. Marah jaakhoh ni nga damdi waan taha di chaattang rah luirong huung mot arah likhiik root rengta, erah ih amah baat tahang, “Anah duung wang thaak ho, ngah ih arah lih adoh marah ang jaatjaat etheng ah erah toom noisok ha.”
Erah damdam Chiiala ah nga sak ni pat taha. Rangmong ni luuwang tongtheng esiit angta, eradi mih esiit tongta.
nyia karnelia jong leepleep likhiik leepta, eno luuwang tongtheng adi kooktum ih emerel jong rah ih saathoi likhiik phaak sotta.

Luuwang tongtheng re adi rooknyi baji tongtheng wak ngoom chookta, erah loong adi rooknyi baji mihak phokhoh loong nyuh epuung ah kap rum ano nyia kom nawa hoon arah luuwang khopok ah kap rum ano tong rumta.
Luuwang tongtheng dowa rangsum phaang phaakta rah, ehuuk eta, rang kahuung ajih huungta. Tongtheng jaakhoh adi nyaapang sinet eluungchoi angta, erah loong ah Rangte chiiala sinet angta.
Erah damdi luuwang tongtheng ngathong loong adi kristal jong liklep singdoong doong esok eh adi muijaang
juungnuh likhiikkhiik angta. Baji ething jih ajaat loong ah neng lih neng ngah ni mik ih loopchoi ang rumta, Erah loong rah ih luuwang tongtheng ah kookchap rumta.
Phangkhoh thoon ah sakhobung likhiik angta; liwang rah maanpong likhiik angta; takjom dowa wah the rah mina the likhiik angta; eno takbajih dowa wah ah laang epuk eh arah likhiik angta.
Ething jih ajaat bajiiji suh neng jang arok totoh ang rumta, eno neng loong sak ni neng jang ni nep mik ih nyum loopchoi ang rumta. Rangwuung rangphe boong lah toihaat thang ih boong rumta:

content.text: “Esa, Esa, Esa, Teesu Rangte ah Elongthoon, heh eje angta, heh eje angla, eno heh eraak ete.”

content: Ething jih ajaat baji loong ah luuwang tongtheng ni tongla raangtaan ih heh rangphoong, heh rangka, nyia lakookmi jeng kot raangtaan ih boongkaat boong rumta, heh ah roitang raangtaan ih tong ah. Neng erah re rum adoh,

rooknyi baji mihak phokhoh loong ah marah tongtheng ni tongta lathong ni bondat wang rumta, eno marah roitang ih tongte angla erah soom rum ah. Neng luuwang khopok loong ah luuwang tongtheng ngathong ni dok haat wan rumta eno jeng rumta,

content.text: “Seng Teesu Rangte! An ephoong esuh, esoomtu esuh,
Mamah liidih an ih jirep dongsiit tu,
eno an thung jun ih erah loong ah ething tong rumla nyia roidong choh rumla.”
